# KalnyesGrowth

> Client Acquisition Systems for Local Businesses

KalnyesGrowth builds automated client acquisition systems for local service businesses. We combine custom websites with AI-powered tools that handle calls, texts, reviews, bookings, and follow-ups 24/7.

## Services

- **Custom Websites**: Professional websites built for local businesses with mobile-first design, SEO optimization, and conversion-focused layouts.
- **AI Voice Receptionist**: Answers calls 24/7, books appointments, and answers FAQs in the business owner's brand voice. $997/mo.
- **Missed-Call Text Back**: Automatically texts missed callers within 5 seconds so no lead is lost. $597/mo.
- **Reviews Automation**: Requests, monitors, and responds to Google reviews automatically. $497/mo.
- **AI Webchat Widget**: Website chat widget that answers customer questions and captures leads 24/7. $497/mo.
- **Unified Messaging Inbox**: One inbox for SMS, email, Facebook, Instagram, Google, and webchat with AI-drafted replies. $797/mo.
- **Smart CRM + Pipelines**: Track every lead, customer, and conversation with AI-powered follow-up sequences. $997/mo.
- **Smart Payments**: Send invoices and collect payments via text or email with automated reminders. $497/mo.
- **Appointment Reminders**: Automated SMS and email reminders to reduce no-shows by 50-70%. $497/mo.
- **Email & SMS Campaigns**: Broadcast promotions, updates, and offers to your customer list with AI-written copy. $697/mo.
- **Online Booking**: Let customers book appointments 24/7 from your website or Google. $299/mo.
- **Customer Reactivation**: Re-engage past customers with automated win-back campaigns. $399/mo.
- **Google Visibility (SEO)**: Monthly SEO service to rank local businesses higher on Google Search and Maps.

## Pricing

### AI Systems (Monthly Bundles)
- Core: $1,497/mo (AI Voice Receptionist + Appointment Reminders + AI Webchat Widget)
- Growth: $2,497/mo (Core + Reviews Automation + Unified Messaging + Smart CRM)
- Scale: $2,997/mo (Growth + Smart Payments + Email & SMS Campaigns + Customer Reactivation + Priority Support)

### Individual AI Agents
- $299 to $997/mo each, depending on the agent. No contracts. Cancel anytime.

### SEO Plans (Monthly)
- Foundation: $497/mo (GBP optimization, on-page SEO, 30+ citations, monthly report)
- Growth: $897/mo (Foundation + 2 blog posts/mo, review strategy, competitor monitoring)
- Dominate: $1,297/mo (Growth + 4 blog posts/mo, backlinks, Google Ads management)
